verdict.rationale: llamafile's server mode documents an HTTP API alongside the llama.cpp Web UI on the same local server (localhost:8080), so a programmatic surface exists next to the UI. Nothing in the evidence describes which endpoints exist or claims the API matches what the UI can do. missing for 10: documented API endpoint reference, explicit UI–API parity claim, a published OpenAPI spec, hands-on corroboration of API usage.
